summary: Iteration 10 — status colour config + row tinting. Backend (4/4 pytest passing) and Frontend (all UI flows verified) work end-to-end. Admin can assign/clear colours per status; receival rows are correctly tinted with inline backgroundColor rgba style in both TILES and TABLE views; 'No colour' reverts rows to default look. Regression on view toggle preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsPage.js status list is rendered inline (~50 lines). Fine for now, but if more attributes are added per status consider extracting a <StatusRow/> component.

hexToRgba/rowTint helpers in ReceivalListPage.js are pure utility functions; consider moving to a small utils file so tile and table views (and any future dashboard chip) can share them without duplication.
PUT /api/statuses does not return the updated document (only 200). Consider returning the updated status object so the client doesn't have to re-list statuses to reconcile.
StatusInput.color has no validation (any string accepted). Consider validating a hex pattern (^#([0-9a-fA-F]{6})$) or null.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ColorStatus in pytest; briefly toggled Pending colour during UI test and restored to #e11d48 via API after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Receivals list is at path '/' (not '/receivals'). View toggle testids: view-toggle, view-tiles, view-table. Row testids: receival-row-<id> (tiles Card) and receival-trow-<id> (table row). Native <input type=color> onChange must be triggered via React native setter + input/change events (page.fill does not fire change on type=color). Verified: swatch style becomes 'background: rgb(...)' when set and 'background: transparent' when cleared; row style becomes 'background-color: rgba(r,g,b,0.14); border-color: rgba(r,g,b,0.55);'.
rca of the issue: No bugs — feature working as designed. Only observation: PUT /api/statuses returns empty {} on success; UI reloads statuses after each mutation which works but could be a small perf improvement to return the doc.
